$comment: Path-matched review rule packs, inspired by alibaba/open-code-review system_rules.json (Apache-2.0). Resolution: for each in-scope file, walk layers in priority order — (1) project <repo>/.reviewrules/manifest.json, (2) user ~/.claude/review-rules/manifest.json, (3) this built-in manifest. Within a layer, entries are evaluated top-to-bottom and the FIRST matching glob wins; once a layer matches, lower layers are not consulted for that file. Patterns support ** recursive match and {a,b} brace expansion. Doc paths are relative to the manifest's own directory.
